task.description: One-sentence restatement of the user's practical task.

recommendations.description: Ranked list of catalog items to use, best fit first.

name.description: Exact name as it appears in the live `dz registry`. Must exist.

why.description: Rationale: how this item maps to the task's real intent.

install.description: Install command, must match `type`: skill -> 'dz init --select <name>'; preset -> 'dz setup --preset <name>'; npx-package -> 'npx @dzhechkov/<name> init'.

pipeline.description: Ordered list of recommended names to run in sequence (for multi-step tasks).

gaps.description: Honest gaps. Empty array means no significant gaps. Suggest /bto-build or dz scout when nothing fits well.
